VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: ATT

The task was to fix the burst-through-at-window-edges bug (a timing/boundary problem in the rate limiting algorithm). The agent's self-report describes fixing a completely different bug—an IP-vs-client-ID keying issue. While the CI log (ATT) independently confirms 52 tests pass, the described change does not address the window-edge burst problem in the acceptance criteria. The passing tests may simply not cover the window-boundary behavior, so the stated acceptance criterion is not demonstrably met.
